Draw the trial layout

Source: R/plot-methods.R
plot.ofe_design.Rd

A plan of the plots, coloured and labelled by treatment. Look at it before the trial goes in: a randomisation that happens to put the same rate at both ends of a slope, or a buffer in the wrong place, is obvious on the map and invisible in the design table.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'ofe_design'
plot(x, label = TRUE, rep_borders = TRUE, main = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

An ofe_design from make_trial_design().

label

Logical; write the treatment on each plot.

rep_borders

Logical; outline the replicate blocks.

main

Plot title.

...

Passed to ofe_map().

Value

x, invisibly.

Details

Every plot carries its treatment label as well as its colour, so the plan stays readable in greyscale, to a colour-blind reader, and past the six treatments the categorical palette is validated for.

Examples

d <- make_trial_design(c("N0", "N60", "N120"), n_rep = 4, seed = 1)
plot(d)
